api.format.detect: Written: Ultralytics cls cx cy w h (0-1, center). Not written: pixel xyxy, xywh.
api.format.segment: Written: Ultralytics polygon cls x1 y1 x2 y2 …. Not written: RLE masks, COCO pixel polygons.
api.format.obb: Written: Ultralytics four corners (8 numbers). Not written by default: cx cy w h angle. If xywhr is read, the angle is radians.
api.format.pose: Written: Ultralytics box plus x y v, v 0/1/2. Not written: keypoints without visibility (dim 2). The box is stored as written. If it is missing, it is derived from the keypoints.
